'''Enhanced Jabba's Palace''' is the 22nd Star Wars CCG product, published by Decipher in January 2000. It is twelve premium cards in four unique die-cut packs (4 Light Side, 8 Dark Side). CardGuide numbering: 22nd product.

Each pack has three premiums (the first visible through the window) plus four [[Jabba's Palace Limited]] boosters. MSRP $14.95; 12 packs per box. The four Jabba's Palace boosters are reprints and are not listed.<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2]</ref>

The four window cards are [[See-Threepio (Enhanced Jabba's Palace)|See-Threepio]], [[Master Luke]], [[Boushh]], and [[Mara Jade, The Emperor's Hand]].

Some Enhanced Jabba's Palace cards leaked into ''Star Trek'' CCG ''The Trouble with Tribbles'' packs. Decipher offered replacement boosters if those cards were returned.<ref name="encyc" />

== Promotion ==

Decipher marketed the set around [[Mara Jade, The Emperor's Hand]]. Model [[Shannon Baksa]] is the photographic likeness. The publisher's summary opened "Can you say Mara Jade? Finally, the fabled character (from the Timothy Zahn novels and 'Tales From Jabba's Palace') comes alive as one of the 12 new Premium cards for this enhanced set." Each of the four die-cut tuck boxes revealed its face card so buyers knew which three premiums they were getting.<ref name="wook-ejp">[https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Enhanced_Jabba%27s_Palace Enhanced Jabba's Palace], Wookieepedia. Publisher's summary.</ref>

On 17 December 1999 Justin Pakes's Decipher Product Spotlight "Are You Ready To Return To The Palace?" started the card-by-card preview with Mara: "Where else could you start your examination of EJP but with the renowned Mara?" He called her "nothing less than a Dark Side main character" on statistics alone, then walked duel text, spy/Undercover, and the first Dark Side dual Alien/Imperial persona. Attendees at [[DecipherCon 1999]] had already seen some EJP cards in the Art Gallery.<ref name="ejp-121799">[https://web.archive.org/web/20010205144100/http://www.decipher.com/calendars/product/spotlight/enhancedjabbaspalace/articles/121799.html Are You Ready To Return To The Palace?], Justin Pakes, Decipher Product Spotlight (17 December 1999). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010205144100/http://www.decipher.com/calendars/product/spotlight/enhancedjabbaspalace/articles/121799.html Wayback, 5 February 2001].</ref>

On 10 January 2000, two days before the 12 January street date, Pakes listed all twelve premiums. Mara Jade, The Emperor's Hand is the visible facing card of her pack, with [[You Can Either Profit By This... / Or Be Destroyed]] and [[Bossk With Mortar Gun]].<ref name="ejp-011000">[https://web.archive.org/web/20010205143400/http://www.decipher.com/calendars/product/spotlight/enhancedjabbaspalace/articles/011000.html "Take me to Enhanced Jabba's Palace now!"], Justin Pakes, Decipher Product Spotlight (10 January 2000). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010205143400/http://www.decipher.com/calendars/product/spotlight/enhancedjabbaspalace/articles/011000.html Wayback, 5 February 2001].</ref>

''Star Wars Insider'' 47 (January 2000) put Baksa on the cover of Lucasfilm's official fan magazine and ran Scott Chernoff's six-page feature [[Mara Jade: Flesh and Blood]] (pages 52–57) on the photoshoot. Decipher creative director Dan Burns told Chernoff they were working on Enhanced Jabba's Palace, Mara was a Power Card, "so I thought, 'What about the possibility of fleshing her out?'" He called the shoot "a really big production for just a little card" that had to pass through Lucasfilm. The magazine printed the finished Mara card on page 54 and listed "STAR WARS CUSTOMIZABLE CARD GAME: JABBA'S PALACE ENHANCED (1999, Decipher)" in its Mara bibliography.<ref name="fab">[[Mara Jade: Flesh and Blood]]</ref>

That cover and feature are a substantial promotional effort for one premium in a twelve-card enhanced product. Mara was heavily marketed. Her later table presence is a separate question from that history.

== Print sheets ==
Premiums print 11&times;11 (121 cards). Dark Side: 9 titles 13&times; plus 4 blanks. Light Side sheet layout is unknown in the encyclopedia.<ref name="encyc" />

== Card list ==

Four die-cut packs. Each pack contains '''three''' premium cards (the face card is visible through the window) plus four [[Jabba's Palace]] Limited boosters. The boosters are not listed. One pack is the [[Boushh]] window; another is [[Mara Jade, The Emperor's Hand]].
